name: Claude
behavior: Musical area attacks - drums = radial shockwave rings on beats 1 and 3, strings = sweeping beams, wind = homing projectiles; attacks follow musical timing, so dodge rhythmically. Floats at 4 u/s keeping within 20 u of the player. Music loop at 100 BPM (beat 0.6 s, bar = 4 beats); one attack per bar, cycling drums/strings/wind. Agitation 0-100 rises 2/s; at 100 (Deadline) all three attacks every bar. A clawd Crab plushie spawns every 25 s on a tile 10-25 u from the player (max 3); picking one up = -35 agitation.
counter_play: its floats keep its body at ceiling 0.55 (4.95 u/s — outwalkable, SR-5); drums: jump on the beat; strings: keep ≥ 6 u from Claude and put a height step or a prop between you and the telegraph line; wind: run in a straight line (7.0 u/s vs 9.0 — you gain 2 u/s) or drop one tread —a shot dies on any slab or riser (D-071).
tell: on beats 1 and 3 a radial ring from Claude — 12 u/s to radius 18 u, 1.0 u tall
